name: @scms/surface-resolver
description: Narrowest end-to-end SSS surface resolution for Semantic CMS (SCMS-008): pure resolver for the focus and collection profiles with typed failures, trace, and access-scoped fingerprints. Types are non-normative derivations of the SSS v0.1.0 reference shapes (normative schemas are owed upstream, UD-13). Zero runtime dependencies; requires Node >= 22.6 (native type stripping).
